dependency_facts.meaning: Exact BSP panel/touch initialization and OTHER/320x480/50rows/rotation0/internal singlebuffer/noPPA/tearNONE reproduced using public handles; brightnessPWM initialized0.
Each panel draw sends command parameters then exactly one tx_color.
Single registered IO callback; IDF sets done flag only on last color segment; callback has no hardware ID. Sender serializes before reuse, no default callback replacement.
refresh_now locks and calls LVGL; public defaultregistration setter and color notification wrapper.
Dummy alone is not ACK; manual public color notification forwards to flush_ready in tearNONE; auto registration disabled before display start.

correlation_limit: IDF callback has no per-transaction ID. Matching relies on no initial inflight color, one serialized physical sender, one callback on final color segment. Model stale-ID tests do not manufacture an absent hardware token.
startup_order: first committed public status before backlighton
